# Wintex Scales

Wintex Scales manufactures electronic weighing scales, weighbridges, precision scales, platform scales, table top scales, jewellery scales, and digital weighing systems in Howrah, West Bengal.

## Pages

- Home: https://www.wintex-scales.com/
- Contact: https://www.wintex-scales.com/enquiry
- Weighbridge: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/electronic-weighbridges — Wintex weighbridges support factories, farms, mills, dispatch yards, and bulk loading operations with modular platform structures, sealed loadcells, and micro-processor based digital indication.
- Unmanned Weighbridge System: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/unmanned-weighbridge-system — A next-gen automated weighbridge workflow with ANPR cameras, RFID vehicle identification, boom barriers, IR positioning sensors, traffic lights, LED displays, voice guidance, CCTV surveillance, and ERP integration.
- Power & Lightning Protection Device: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/power-lightning-protection-device — A protection panel for weighbridge electronics that guards indicators and connected systems from voltage surges, lightning risk, unstable line conditions, and unsafe earthing.
- Heavy Duty Platform Scale: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/heavy-duty-platform-scale — Wintex heavy duty platform scales are built for industrial floor weighing, bulky item weighing, factories, warehouses, shipping and receiving departments, and loading docks where durable construction and dependable accuracy matter.
- Table Top Scale: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/table-top-scale — A stainless-steel digital table top weighing scale for fast counter weighing, built with a front LED display and high-sensitivity loadcell.
- Chicken Scale: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/chicken-scale — A practical weighing scale for poultry and food counters, included in the Wintex table-top/platform range for fast commercial weighing.
- Jewellery Scale: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/jewellery-scale — A high-sensitivity precision scale for jewellery, valuables, laboratory measurements, and fine counter weighing.
- Micro Mini Scale: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/micro-mini-scale — A compact precision scale from the Wintex precision range, designed for small-footprint weighing and component-level work.
- Digital Indicator / IT: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/digital-indicator-it — Wintex digital indicator and intelligent terminal systems support weighbridge operation with data processing, printing, communication, and reliable field use.
- Load Cells: https://www.wintex-scales.com/products/load-cells — Wintex load cells for weighbridge applications, available in 30 t and 42.5 t capacities. Discuss your platform and weighing system with our team to select the right configuration.
